How it works

A normal pump.fun coin, with its creator fees locked to its shillers.

  1. You launch it. Your wallet signs and pays the launch, plus your first buy if you add one. The coin appears on pump.fun right away.
  2. Its fees get a wallet. GET-PAID sets the coin's creator to a payout wallet made just for this coin. Nobody can move its fees anywhere else.
  3. People shill it. The coin gets its own page here. People post about it on X, and the bot checks each post mentions it and talks it up.
  4. Fees pay them. As the coin trades, its creator fees pay approved posts in SOL, oldest first. Every payout is public on Solscan.

You do not receive the coin's creator fees yourself: they all go to the people who shill it. You keep any coins from your first buy.
